the_problem: Footwear maker Grupo Becker, owned by Alexandre Becker, fell into severe financial difficulty after the pandemic and after losing work from client Paquetá Calçados, and was behind on FGTS contributions for four years per former workers.
the_decision: Alexandre Becker closed four Pentecoste (CE) plants on 24 June 2026 saying "Chegou um momento em que a gente está passando por uma dificuldade econômica muito grande. Essa dificuldade impossibilita a gente de continuar"; he promised to keep VS Sport open but it shut too, and the JA Calçados plant in Brejo Santo closed in late July.
the_outcome: Six plants closed in 35 days; 5 Pentecoste plants cut 830+ jobs (23 Jun-22 Jul) plus 89 dismissed at Brejo Santo; unions won a court asset-freeze order over unpaid severance.
